title: Harnessing Language Models as Optimization Modeling Agents
title_zh: 将语言模型用作优化建模智能体

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) can translate natural-language optimization problems into solver programs, but reliably producing correct formulations and implementations remains challenging. Existing approaches improve optimization modeling through agentic workflows or task-specific post-training. This raises a practical question: can a lightweight harness using a single model role achieve competitive performance without additional training? We introduce OptiCycle and OptiState , two lightweight inference harnesses for optimization modeling, and evaluate them on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems using 11 Qwen variants spanning 0.6B–27B parameters. Our results show that execution-guided revision consistently improves macro accuracy over direct generation for all evaluated models, with gains of up to 49.46 percentage. Despite the simplicity, both harnesses outperform six adapted agentic workflows under same model comparisons and four evaluated post-trained optimization models at comparable model sizes without additional training. Explicit formulation state provides further but model-dependent improvements, suggesting that additional structure is not universally beneficial.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）可以将自然语言优化问题转化为求解器程序，但要可靠地生成正确的建模与实现仍然具有挑战性。 现有方法通过智能体工作流或针对任务的后训练来改进优化建模。 由此引出一个实际问题：仅使用单一模型角色的轻量级框架，能否在不进行额外训练的情况下取得有竞争力的性能？ 我们提出 OptiCycle 和 OptiState，这是两个面向优化建模的轻量级推理框架，并在包含 2,634 个问题的九个基准上，使用参数规模覆盖 0.6B–27B 的 11 个 Qwen 变体对其进行评估。 我们的结果表明，对于所有被评估的模型，执行引导的修订在宏平均准确率上一致优于直接生成，提升幅度最高达 49.46 个百分点。 尽管方法简单，两个框架在同模型对比中优于六个改造后的智能体工作流，并在相近模型规模下优于四个经过后训练的优化模型，且无需额外训练。 显式建模状态带来进一步但依赖模型的提升，这表明额外结构并非普遍有益。

paragraphs.en: Operations research (OR) provides a principled foundation for decision-making in resource-constrained settings, with optimization models supporting applications such as supply-chain management and transportation Dantzig (1963) ; Hillier et al. (1995) . In practice, an optimization problem often begins as a natural-language description of the decision context, available resources , and desired outcomes. Translating this description into a correct optimization model requires identifying decision variables, an objective, and constraints while preserving the semantics of the original problem Ramamonjison et al. (2023) . Natural-language optimization modeling therefore connects language understanding, mathematical formulation, and executable problem solving.
paragraphs.zh: 运筹学（OR）为资源受限环境下的决策提供了原则性基础，其优化模型支撑着供应链管理和交通运输等应用 Dantzig (1963) ； Hillier et al. (1995) 。 在实践中，一个优化问题通常始于对决策背景、可用资源和期望目标的自然语言描述。 将这一描述翻译成正确的优化模型，需要识别决策变量、目标和约束条件，同时保留原始问题的语义 Ramamonjison et al. (2023) 。 因此，自然语言优化建模将语言理解、数学形式化和可执行的问题求解连接了起来。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) offer a way to automate this translation from problem descriptions to executable optimization models. Existing approaches pursue two complementary directions. One organizes inference through specialized agents or stages for formulation, coding, and debugging Xiao et al. (2024) ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) . The other treats it as a reasoning task and develops domain-specific capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL) Huang et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2025) . The two directions differ in whether they modify the inference workflow or the model parameters.

paragraphs.en: Agentic post-training further connects model capabilities with the systems surrounding them: models can be trained to use tools and interact with environments Kimi Team (2025) ; GLM-4.5 Team (2025) , but the opportunities to exercise these capabilities depend on the inference procedure. The same frozen LLM can act as a direct generator or repeatedly execute and revise a solver program. An inference harness is the layer that organizes an LLM’s tools, context, state, and control flow Meng et al. (2026) . Comparisons across optimization systems are difficult to interpret when backbones, benchmarks, inference procedures, and grading protocols all differ. This motivates our central question: how do different harnesses shape the optimization-modeling performance of a frozen LLM, and when does explicit formulation state add value?

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we study this question through a unified harness view of optimization modeling ( Figure 1 ). Direct Generation is the single-step setting : the model produces a solver program without an opportunity to revise it after execution. We design two OR-oriented harnesses for interactive modeling. OptiCycle organizes code generation, solver execution, feedback interpretation, and revision into a cycle within a persistent Python environment. OptiState adds a structured and revisable formulation comprising sets, parameters, variables, the objective, and constraints. This state makes intermediate modeling decisions explicit and available for reconsideration during subsequent interaction. Both harnesses use a single model role with frozen weights; reference answers remain hidden , and grading occurs only after submission.
paragraphs.zh: 本文通过统一的测试框架视角来研究优化建模中的这一问题（图 1）。 直接生成是单步设定：模型生成求解器程序后，没有机会在执行后对其进行修改。 我们为交互式建模设计了两个面向运筹学的测试框架。 OptiCycle 在一个持久的 Python 环境中，将代码生成、求解器执行、反馈解释与修订组织成一个循环。 OptiState 增加了一个结构化且可修订的建模形式，包含集合、参数、变量、目标函数和约束。 这一状态使中间建模决策显式化，并可在后续交互中被重新审视。 两个测试框架均使用权重冻结的单一模型角色；参考答案保持隐藏，评分仅在提交后进行。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate these settings on nine benchmarks comprising 2,634 problems and 11 Qwen variants from 0.6B to 27B parameters. OptiCycle improves Qwen3.5-9B macro accuracy by 18.74 percentage points over Direct Generation. In a shared-backbone comparison with six adapted OR workflows, it achieves 62.74% on Qwen3-4B and 65.21% on Qwen3.5-9B , exceeding the strongest competing baselines by 8.53 and 4.29 percentage points, respectively. These comparisons share the backbone and evaluation protocol while retaining method-specific inference budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在包含 2,634 道题目的九个基准以及从 0.6B 到 27B 参数的 11 个 Qwen 变体上评估这些设置。 OptiCycle 使 Qwen3.5-9B 的宏平均准确率相比 Direct Generation 提升了 18.74 个百分点。 在与六个经过适配的运筹学工作流的同骨干对比中，它在 Qwen3-4B 上取得 62.74%，在 Qwen3.5-9B 上取得 65.21%，分别超过最强竞争基线 8.53 和 4.29 个百分点。 这些对比共享相同的骨干与评估协议，同时保留各方法自身的推理预算。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on LLM-based optimization modeling broadly follows two methodological directions: improving inference-time modeling procedures and adapting model parameters specifically for optimization tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的优化建模研究大致遵循两个方法论方向：改进推理阶段的建模流程，以及针对优化任务对模型参数进行专门调整。

paragraphs.en: One direction improves optimization modeling through task-specific prompting and structured inference workflows. Existing systems organize formulation, coding, execution and debugging into coordinated stages or specialized roles Deng et al. (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2024) ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) ; Monteiro et al. (2026) . Beyond stage decomposition, recent approaches explore formulation search, execution-aware verification, iterative repair, and the reuse of correction experiences Astorga et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2026) ; Xie et al. (2026) . These methods improve the inference process without necessarily changing the underlying model. Our work focuses on this setting, studying OR-oriented harnesses that support iterative modeling within a single agent role while holding model weights fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 一个方向是通过任务特定的提示和结构化的推理工作流来改进优化建模。 现有系统将建模、编码、执行和调试组织为相互协调的阶段或专门化的角色 Deng et al. (2024) ; Xiao et al. (2024) ; AhmadiTeshnizi et al. (2024) ; Monteiro et al. (2026) 。 这些方法在不改变底层模型的情况下改进了推理过程。 我们的工作聚焦于这一设定，研究面向运筹学的支撑框架（harness），使其在模型权重保持固定的情况下，支持单个智能体角色内的迭代建模。

paragraphs.en: We organize optimization modeling around a frozen language model and a harness that controls its execution environment, interaction history , and persistent state. Within this view, Direct Generation is the single-step setting, OptiCycle introduces execution-guided revision, and OptiState additionally exposes a revisable formulation (Figure 1 ). Both of our harnesses use one model role and keep its weights fixed throughout inference.

paragraphs.en: The harness separates the model’s proposed computation from its execution. The model produces code, the environment runs it, and the controller determines what feedback and state are available for the next call and when to stop. Direct Generation makes one model call to produce a complete solver program and executes it once. It has no opportunity to revise the program after observing its behavior. Our interactive harnesses maintain execution state across calls and provide summaries of recent actions and observations, allowing the same model to revise its work.
paragraphs.zh: 该框架将模型提出的计算与其执行分离开来。 模型生成代码，环境运行代码，而控制器决定下一次调用时有哪些反馈和状态可用，以及何时停止。 直接生成只需一次模型调用即可生成一个完整的求解器程序，并执行一次。 它没有机会在观察到程序的行为之后对该程序进行修订。 我们的交互式框架会在多次调用之间维护执行状态，并提供近期动作和观察的摘要，使同一个模型能够修订其工作。

paragraphs.en: OptiCycle organizes optimization modeling as a sequence of code generation, execution, observation , and revision. The model can build a solver program incrementally, inspect its behavior, and choose its next operation from the execution results . Each trajectory runs in a persistent Python interpreter, so imported modules, variables, and solver objects remain available across turns. This continuity lets the model resume from its current work: it can repair an indexing error, modify a constraint , or rerun a solver using objects it has already created.
paragraphs.zh: OptiCycle 将优化建模组织为代码生成、执行、观察和修订的序列。 该模型可以逐步构建求解器程序，检查其行为，并根据执行结果选择下一步操作。 每条轨迹都在一个持久化的 Python 解释器中运行，因此已导入的模块、变量和求解器对象在各轮之间保持可用。 这种连续性使模型能够从当前的工作进度继续：它可以修复索引错误、修改约束，或使用已经创建好的对象重新运行求解器。

paragraphs.en: The harness separates persistent execution state from the context presented to the model. The interpreter retains live objects, workspace files store intermediate artifacts, and the prompt combines the original problem with a bounded summary of recent actions and execution feedback. These summaries record the purpose of each action and the resulting output or exception. Together with optimization-specific modeling instructions and recovery hints, they guide the next code operation while keeping the interaction context compact.

paragraphs.en: Adding explicit formulation state produces selective gains (Figure 2 , left). Its contribution is therefore more dependent on the backbone than the gains from executable interaction.

paragraphs.en: Our results suggest that a simple execution-and-revision harness is most useful when tasks challenge direct generation but remain within the model’s capabilities. ComplexOR illustrates this pattern: OptiCycle substantially improves over Direct Generation on both shared backbones. Gains are smaller on MAMO-easy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B , where direct generation accuracy is already high. Interaction also offers little benefit for some difficult model–task pairs, such as Qwen3-8B on MAMO-complex (Tables 5 and 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的结果表明，一个简单的「执行—修订」框架在任务对直接生成构成挑战但仍处于模型能力范围之内时最为有用。 ComplexOR 体现了这一模式：在两个共享骨干模型上，OptiCycle 都大幅优于直接生成。 在 MAMO-easy 上，Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的收益较小，因为其直接生成准确率已经很高。 对于某些困难的模型—任务组合，交互也几乎没有什么益处，例如 Qwen3-8B 在 MAMO-complex 上（见表 5 和表 6）。

sents.en: Gains are smaller on MAMO-easy for Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B , where direct generation accuracy is already high.
sents.zh: 在 MAMO-easy 上，Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 的收益较小，因为其直接生成准确率已经很高。

sents.en: Interaction also offers little benefit for some difficult model–task pairs, such as Qwen3-8B on MAMO-complex (Tables 5 and 6 ).
sents.zh: 对于某些困难的模型—任务组合，交互也几乎没有什么益处，例如 Qwen3-8B 在 MAMO-complex 上（见表 5 和表 6）。

paragraphs.en: These findings are consistent with a harness helping models make better use of their existing capabilities, with limited headroom on easier tasks and persistent capability constraints on harder ones. Difficulty alone, however, does not determine the gains: OptMath improves substantially despite low final accuracy, showing that interaction can help even when reliable task completion remains out of reach.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现与以下解释一致：框架（harness）能帮助模型更好地利用其现有能力，在较简单的任务上提升空间有限，而在较难的任务上能力限制依然存在。 然而，仅凭难度并不能决定收益大小：OptMath 在最终准确率较低的情况下仍取得了显著提升，这表明即使可靠地完成任务仍遥不可及，交互也能带来帮助。

paragraphs.zh: 显式表述状态在可执行交互之外提供了额外的增益，但其价值取决于主干模型和任务。 对于 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3.5-4B，OptiState 在全部九个基准上均优于 OptiCycle，表明其对这两个模型具有广泛的收益（表 5 和表 6）。

These results suggest that the value of explicit formulation state should be assessed for each model and task, rather than assumed to improve the execution loop uniformly.

paragraphs.en: We studied optimization modeling as an executable inference task for frozen language models. Across nine benchmarks and 11 Qwen variants , a lightweight execution-and-repair harness substantially improves performance over direct generation for models above 1B parameters and outperforms the evaluated adapted architectures with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3.5-9B . Explicit formulation state provides additional, model-dependent gains. The same workflow also improves accuracy on Phi, Magistral, and GPT-OSS.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将优化建模作为一种可执行的推理任务，对冻结的语言模型进行了研究。 在九个基准测试和 11 个 Qwen 变体上，一个轻量级的执行与修复框架显著提升了参数量超过 1B 的模型的性能，使其优于直接生成，并在使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 时超越了所评估的自适应架构。 显式的公式化状态带来了额外的、依赖于模型的收益。 同样的工作流程也提升了 Phi、Magistral 和 GPT-OSS 的准确率。

sents.en: We studied optimization modeling as an executable inference task for frozen language models.
sents.zh: 我们将优化建模作为一种可执行的推理任务，对冻结的语言模型进行了研究。

sents.en: Across nine benchmarks and 11 Qwen variants , a lightweight execution-and-repair harness substantially improves performance over direct generation for models above 1B parameters and outperforms the evaluated adapted architectures with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3.5-9B .
sents.zh: 在九个基准测试和 11 个 Qwen 变体上，一个轻量级的执行与修复框架显著提升了参数量超过 1B 的模型的性能，使其优于直接生成，并在使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 时超越了所评估的自适应架构。

sents.en: Explicit formulation state provides additional, model-dependent gains.
sents.zh: 显式的公式化状态带来了额外的、依赖于模型的收益。

sents.en: The same workflow also improves accuracy on Phi, Magistral, and GPT-OSS.
sents.zh: 同样的工作流程也提升了 Phi、Magistral 和 GPT-OSS 的准确率。

paragraphs.en: An important direction is a self-evolving harness that improves its inference workflow across tasks while keeping the underlying model frozen. Rather than revising only a task’s code or formulation, such a framework could use historical execution trajectories to propose changes to prompts, feedback processing , state representations , and repair-budget allocation . Candidate harnesses could be evaluated on a separate development set and retained when they improve accuracy under explicit cost constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 一个重要方向是一种自我进化的执行框架，它在跨任务的同时改进自身的推理流程，同时保持底层模型冻结不变。 这样的框架不只是修改某个任务的代码或表述方式，还可以利用历史执行轨迹，对提示词、反馈处理、状态表示以及修复预算分配提出修改建议。 候选的执行框架可以在一个独立的开发集上进行评估，并在显式成本约束下提升准确率时被保留。

sents.zh: 一个重要方向是一种自我进化的执行框架，它在跨任务的同时改进自身的推理流程，同时保持底层模型冻结不变。

sents.en: Rather than revising only a task’s code or formulation, such a framework could use historical execution trajectories to propose changes to prompts, feedback processing , state representations , and repair-budget allocation .

paragraphs.en: While our harnesses improve optimization-modeling performance across the evaluated benchmarks, the experiments compare complete workflows with method-specific inference budgets. In particular, OptiState adds both an initial formulation call and a revisable representation to OptiCycle . We report recorded token consumption for the Qwen3.5-9B comparison; matched-budget ablations, trajectory-level repair analysis, and latency measurements can further clarify the contributions and costs of individual components.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然我们的测试框架在所评估的基准上提升了优化建模性能，但实验比较的是使用特定于方法的推理预算的完整工作流。 具体而言，OptiState 在 OptiCycle 的基础上增加了初始公式化调用和一个可修订的表示。 我们报告了 Qwen3.5-9B 比较中记录的 token 消耗；匹配预算的消融实验、轨迹层面的修复分析以及延迟测量可以进一步厘清各个组件的贡献与成本。

paragraphs.en: We have primarily evaluated 11 Qwen variants, with additional experiments on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, Phi-4-reasoning, Magistral-Small-2509, and GPT-OSS-20B. Configuration revisions differ across model generations, so these results characterize the evaluated model–harness settings. The reported accuracies are point estimates without uncertainty intervals; broader model coverage and uncertainty quantification would further strengthen the empirical findings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们主要评估了 11 个 Qwen 变体，并对 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Phi-4-reasoning、Magistral-Small-2509 和 GPT-OSS-20B 进行了补充实验。 配置修订在不同模型世代之间有所差异，因此这些结果刻画的是所评估的模型—测试框架设置。 所报告的准确率是不带不确定性区间的点估计；更广泛的模型覆盖和不确定性量化将进一步增强这些实证结论。

paragraphs.en: Finally, our evaluation uses objective-value or status agreement as a common outcome-level measure across benchmarks. Extending verification to decision-vector feasibility, constraint satisfaction, and formulation equivalence would provide a more comprehensive assessment of modeling correctness.

paragraphs.en: This work studies the use of language models for automated optimization modeling. Incorrect formulations or solver implementations may produce misleading solutions, especially in consequential decision-making settings. Our evaluation focuses on benchmark accuracy and does not establish reliability for real-world deployment. Human verification remains important before applying generated optimization models. Additionally, repeated model inference and solver execution incur computational costs.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究探讨如何利用语言模型进行自动化优化建模。 错误的建模或求解器实现可能产生具有误导性的解，尤其是在影响重大的决策场景中。 我们的评估聚焦于基准测试准确率，并未确立其在真实部署中的可靠性。 在应用生成的优化模型之前，人工验证仍然十分重要。 此外，反复进行模型推理和求解器运行会带来计算成本。

paragraphs.en: For the Qwen3.5-9B comparison, we use the current evaluated runs and exclude archived retries. Each method has 17,852 scored trajectories with recorded input and output token counts. paragraphs.en: Generated programs execute in Python with SciPy, PuLP, and PySCIPOpt. The runner uses host subprocesses within temporary task directories; hidden grader files are not copied into these directories. Baseline inference used eight independent vLLM endpoints. Structured JSON, routing, and compilation stages may use direct decoding, while stages involving semantic analysis, search, or traceback debugging retain reasoning, according to each harness’s configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的程序在 Python 中执行，使用 SciPy、PuLP 和 PySCIPOpt。 运行器在临时任务目录中使用主机子进程；隐藏的评分文件不会被复制到这些目录中。 基线推理使用了八个独立的 vLLM 端点。 结构化 JSON、路由和编译阶段可以使用直接解码，而涉及语义分析、搜索或回溯调试的阶段则保留推理过程，具体取决于每个测试框架的配置。

paragraphs.en: For each benchmark, avg@ k k is the percentage of correct trajectories among all planned samples over all problems. Trajectories with missing scores count as incorrect and remain in the denominator. It is an estimate of average single-trajectory accuracy, not the probability that at least one of k k samples succeeds. Macro accuracy is the unweighted mean of these benchmark accuracies. The grader compares numerical objective values using absolute tolerance 10 − 2 10^{-2} and relative tolerance 10 − 4 10^{-4} , or checks agreement on infeasible / unbounded status. Missing or unparseable answers count as failures. Grading is performed after inference and is not used for search, reflection, or candidate selection.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个基准测试，avg@ k k 表示所有问题上全部规划样本中正确轨迹所占的百分比。 缺失评分的轨迹计为错误，并保留在分母中。 它是对平均单条轨迹准确率的估计，而不是 k k 个样本中至少有一个成功的概率。 宏观准确率是这些基准测试准确率的未加权平均值。 评分器使用绝对容差 10 − 2 10^{-2} 和相对容差 10 − 4 10^{-4} 比较数值目标值，或检查是否在不可行 / 无界状态上一致。 缺失或无法解析的答案计为失败。 评分在推理之后进行，不用于搜索、反思或候选选择。
